name: Open-Meteo
description: Weather and forecast data useful for location planning, operations, and campaign timing.
rateLimitNote: Free non-commercial access; review provider limits before production use.

tools.name: open_meteo_forecast
tools.description: Get a forecast for a latitude and longitude.

current.description: Comma-separated current variables, for example temperature_2m.

name: World Bank Indicators
description: Public economic and development indicators for market research and country comparisons.
rateLimitNote: Public service; use pagination and cache repeated research queries.

tools.name: world_bank_indicator
tools.description: Fetch an indicator for one country and year range.

date.description: Year or year range such as 2015:2024.

name: REST Countries
description: Country metadata for regional segmentation, localization, and market research.
rateLimitNote: Public endpoint; avoid high-volume polling and cache stable country metadata.

tools.name: country_lookup
tools.description: Look up country metadata by name, code, or region.

name: Zippopotam.us
description: Resolve postal codes to locality and administrative-region data.
rateLimitNote: Community public service; validate results against a production address provider when required.

tools.name: postal_code_lookup
tools.description: Resolve a postal code for a country into places and regions.

name: ipify
description: Return the caller's public IP address for diagnostics and network-aware workflows.
rateLimitNote: Public endpoint; use sparingly in diagnostics rather than as an identity system.

tools.name: get_public_ip
tools.description: Get the public IP address seen by the service.

name: Frankfurter
description: Reference exchange rates and currency conversion from a public, keyless service.
rateLimitNote: Reference rates are not a trading or settlement feed; cache and disclose rate timing.

tools.name: convert_currency
tools.description: Convert an amount using the latest available reference rate.

name: CoinGecko Markets
description: Public cryptocurrency market data for lightweight research and monitoring.
rateLimitNote: Public/demo access is rate-limited; use caching and do not treat data as an execution feed.

tools.name: crypto_market_snapshot
tools.description: List market data for selected cryptocurrencies.

vs_currency.description: Fiat or crypto quote currency, for example usd.

name: Jina Reader
description: Convert a public URL into clean, model-friendly text for research and extraction.
rateLimitNote: Unauthenticated use is rate-limited; respect target-site terms and robots policies.

tools.name: read_public_url
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return its reader-friendly text representation.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL to read.

name: AllOrigins
description: Fetch public resources through a CORS-friendly proxy for simple parsing workflows.
rateLimitNote: Community proxy with shared capacity; never send private URLs or sensitive data.

tools.name: fetch_public_resource
tools.description: Fetch a public URL through the raw AllOrigins endpoint.
